title: Manifest Proposal
description: Generated when saturation criteria are met. Represents an induced artifact awaiting explicit acceptance or dismissal.

zone.description: The zone where saturation was detected.

saturation_spec_id.description: The saturation rule that generated this proposal.

confidence.description: Derived from signal strength and lineage diversity.

actor_count.description: Number of independent actors whose signals contributed.

expires_at_unix.description: When the proposal expires if not acted upon.

accepted_at_unix.description: When the proposal was accepted (if applicable).

accepted_by.description: Actor who accepted the proposal (if applicable).

dismissed_at_unix.description: When the proposal was dismissed (if applicable).

dismissed_by.description: Actor who dismissed the proposal (if applicable).

retired_at_unix.description: When the proposal was retired (if applicable).
